tagline.en: Wan 2.7 as a hosted API — image-to-video through Alibaba's DashScope, no local GPU needed.
tagline.zh: 以托管 API 形式提供的 Wan 2.7——通过阿里云 DashScope 使用图生视频,无需本地 GPU。

en: Wan 2.7 API is a hosted route to the Wan video model, served through Alibaba's DashScope platform rather than run locally. Here it exposes image-to-video generation.
As a cloud service, there are no weights to download and no GPU to provision — you send an image (with your prompt) and receive generated video back. You supply your own DashScope API key.
In WorldFoundry you use it through the hosted-API pipeline: configure your key and the service handles generation on the provider side.
zh: Wan 2.7 API 是 Wan 视频模型的托管方式,通过阿里云 DashScope 平台提供,而非本地运行。这里它暴露的是图生视频生成。
作为云服务,无需下载权重、也无需准备 GPU——你发送一张图片(连同提示词),即可拿回生成的视频。你需要自备 DashScope API key。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过托管 API pipeline 使用它:配置好 key,生成由服务商侧完成。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to animate an image with the latest hosted Wan generation, without setting up local hardware.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用最新的托管 Wan 让图片动起来、又不必搭建本地硬件时用它。

notFor.en: Not for offline use — it requires network access and your own API key, and output availability depends on the provider's service.
notFor.zh: 不适合离线使用——它需要联网并自备 API key,输出是否可用取决于服务商的服务。

en: Hosted API — no local weights or GPU required
zh: 托管 API——无需本地权重或 GPU
通过阿里云 DashScope 平台提供
